mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing overcast skies near Verona Area High School. Tonight, under the new moon, keep your eyes on the western horizon toward Mount Horeb at 8:21 PM to see the space station pass overhead toward Madison for six minutes.

In city news, the Verona Police Department is accepting applications for their upcoming Citizen Academy starting September 23, and residents are also encouraged to review the public notices regarding the upcoming November general election.

We have a packed schedule today with the Dane County Farmer's Market and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the city will host the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival on Main Street.
On September 10, officers responded to a burglary on Hunter's Cove Way, resulting in the arrest of a 19-year-old suspect on charges of burglary and O W I related reckless endangerment.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is Caramel Cashew. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to head over for a snack.
